research_question: Do material, dated increases or decreases in economically available token supply produce directionally consistent market-adjusted returns?

event_selection.materiality_rule: An event is eligible when its evidenced gross supply impact is at least 0.5% of circulating supply measured immediately before the event.
event_selection.direction_rule: Unlocks, vesting releases, and issuance increases are positive supply shocks with an expected negative return sign. Burns and issuance reductions are negative supply shocks with an expected positive return sign.

contamination.policy: Contaminated events remain in the audit ledger but are excluded from the primary pooled estimate and included only in a labeled sensitivity.

reporting: Report every sourced candidate and every exclusion reason.
Report individual-event and pooled estimates, including sign-reversed and null outcomes.
Show event-time cumulative abnormal return charts with sample counts.
Do not interpret announcement-date anticipation as an effective-date treatment effect.
Do not make causal, price-target, or investment-recommendation claims.
